description: This file implements the Customer Data Access Object (DAO) using JPA and Querydsl, providing methods to retrieve customer data by various criteria such as ID, name, nickname, and store details. It interacts with the database to perform complex queries involving customer relationships and associated entities.

classes.name: CustomerDAOImpl
classes.description: Implements data access methods for Customer entities, extending generic DAO functionality and integrating Querydsl for complex queries.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by ID, eagerly fetching related entities such as merchant store, language, attributes, and options.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching a given name, joining related entities to load complete customer data.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific store, applying optional criteria for pagination and filtering.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname, optionally filtered by store ID, with related entities eagerly loaded.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all customers for a given store without additional filtering.
